result.document_summary: A portion of the San Diego Municipal Code, Chapter 5, Article 2 (Police Regulations), covering illegal speed contest spectator offenses and forfeiture of nuisance vehicles used in street racing, published on a code-library page.
result.notes: This part of the document contains only San Diego Municipal Code provisions on street racing spectators and vehicle forfeiture (Div. 52-53). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting, despite the page URL referring to an anti-competitive automated rent price-fixing division (Div. 11, § 98.1103); that rent-pricing text does not appear in this part.
